title: Robust Langevin Sampling under State-Dependent Heavy-Tailed Noise with Applications to LLM Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.12865v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing convergence guarantees for non-log-concave sampling with stochastic gradient Langevin Monte Carlo (SG-LMC) typically assume globally Lipschitz gradients and uniformly bounded noise variance. Both assumptions can fail even in elementary sampling problems, and relaxing them better reflects practical applications such as Bayesian fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs). We relax both assumptions through generalized smoothness and our proposed state-dependent heavy-tailed oracle with finite $p$-th moments, $1<2$ and includes the Blum-Gladyshev (BG-0) condition. We study these relaxations separately and jointly, proposing three methods. Under globally Lipschitz gradients, robust LMC (R-LMC) handles the proposed oracle through geometric-median centering and residual clipping. With exact gradients, adaptive LMC (A-LMC) controls discretization error under generalized smoothness. Robust adaptive LMC (RA-LMC) addresses both relaxation

translated_title: 状态依赖重尾噪声下的鲁棒朗之万采样及其在大语言模型微调中的应用
translated_abstract: 现有针对非对数凹采样的随机梯度朗之万蒙特卡洛（SG-LMC）方法的收敛性保证，通常假设梯度全局Lipschitz连续且噪声方差一致有界。这两个假设即使在基本的采样问题中也可能不成立，而放松它们能更好地反映诸如大语言模型（LLM）贝叶斯微调等实际应用场景。我们通过广义光滑性以及所提出的状态依赖重尾预言机（具有有限p阶矩，且包含Blum-Gladyshev（BG-0）条件）来放松这两个假设。我们分别以及联合地研究这些放松，并提出了三种方法：在梯度全局Lipschitz连续的条件下，鲁棒LMC（R-LMC）通过几何中位数中心化和残差裁剪来处理所提出的重尾预言机；在精确梯度条件下，自适应LMC（A-LMC）在广义光滑性下控制离散化误差；鲁棒自适应LMC（RA-LMC）则同时应对这两种放松（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出R-LMC、A-LMC和RA-LMC三种朗之万采样算法，通过引入广义光滑性和状态依赖重尾噪声假设，放松了传统SG-LMC对全局Lipschitz梯度与有界噪声方差的要求，并将其应用于大语言模型的贝叶斯微调。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes three Langevin sampling methods—R-LMC, A-LMC, and RA-LMC—that relax the global Lipschitz gradient and bounded noise variance assumptions via generalized smoothness and a state-dependent heavy-tailed oracle, with applications to Bayesian fine-tuning of LLMs.
